evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equates rehearsal with possession of a capability, appealing to security/stability (conservation) and mastery/readiness (competence) as the goods that justify the directive.
Cadence language frames recurring practice as a stability mechanism — conservation of a reliable rollback capability.
Assigning ownership names a single accountable party for the capability, appealing to competence as the good of having a designated master.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with demonstrated readiness for it, rather than merely asserting the capability exists?
